content.title: NASA’s Artemis II mission launches on historic journey to the moon - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Carolyn Y. JohnsonFour astronauts have begun a historic 10-day journey to fly by the moon and propel people farther into space than they have ever gone before.The Artemis II mission, which lifted off before sunset Wednesday, is scheduled to loop around the moon for the first time since the Apollo era. It is a crucial first chapter for an ambitious and risky program to eventually return people to the lunar surface, build a base there and use it as a stepping stone to push deeper into the solar system.Related ArticlesChristian DavenportInside the Space Force as it prepares for a new kind of warSeptember 19, 2025Dana MunroA Maryland astronaut achieves his childhood dream of traveling to spaceDecember 26, 2025Joel AchenbachTrump’s NASA budget could cede solar system to China, scientists warnJuly 8, 2025Kasha Patel and Hannah NatansonNASA has lost thousands of workers.
